question.html:
A student makes three claims about a main sequence star:

I. The star will eventually evolve into a white dwarf.

II. The outward radiation pressure prevents the star from collapsing under its own weight.

III. In the core of the star hydrogen is fusing into helium.

Which of these claims are definitely correct?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
